appellations.name: Pauillac
appellations.climate: Maritime temperate, influenced by the Gironde estuary and Atlantic ocean
appellations.soil_type: Deep gravel mounds (croupes de graves) over limestone and clay subsoils
typical_styles: Full-bodied, powerful, structured red wine with firm tannins, cedar, and cassis notes

appellations.name: Mercurey
appellations.climate: Continental with warm summers and cold winters
appellations.soil_type: Jurassic limestone and marl with rich iron deposits
typical_styles: Vibrant red berry fruit, earthy minerality, firm but elegant tannins

appellations.name: Chablis
appellations.climate: Semi-continental, cool climate with spring frost risk
appellations.soil_type: Kimmeridgian limestone rich in fossilized oyster shells (Exogyra virgula)
typical_styles: High natural acidity, flinty mineral character, green apple and citrus, typically unoaked

appellations.name: Côtes du Rhône
appellations.climate: Mediterranean, hot and sunny with Mistral wind moderating humidity
appellations.soil_type: Alluvial stony soils, clay-limestone terraces, and rolled pebbles (galets roulés)
typical_styles: Juicy red and dark fruit, warming alcohol, garrigue herb nuances, accessible tannins

appellations.name: Chianti Classico
appellations.climate: Sub-Mediterranean continental, warm sunny days and cool nights
appellations.soil_type: Galestro (crumbly schistous clay) and Alberese (compact limestone)
typical_styles: High acidity, firm rustic tannins, sour cherry, dried herbs, and savoury leather

appellations.name: Rioja
appellations.climate: Continental-Atlantic convergence, protected by the Sierra de Cantabria
appellations.soil_type: Chalky clay (arcillo-calcáreo), ferruginous clay, and alluvial silt
typical_styles: Oak-influenced elegance, red fruit, vanilla, dill, and polished tannins

appellations.name: Sancerre
appellations.soil_type: Silex (flint), Terres Blanches (Kimmeridgian marl), and Caillottes (limestone pebbles)
typical_styles: Crisp mineral-driven white, gooseberry, citrus pith, gunflint, and brisk acidity

appellations.name: Bourgueil
appellations.soil_type: Tuffeau limestone and siliceous alluvial terraces (tuffeau et graviers)
typical_styles: Red fruit, raspberry, structured graphite mineral core, fine tannins

appellations.name: Chinon
appellations.climate: Oceanic with continental microclimates along the Vienne river
appellations.soil_type: Alluvial gravel terraces (graves) and limestone slopes (craie tuffeau)
typical_styles: Vibrant red cherry, pencil lead, leafy spice, supple to firm structure

appellations.name: Muscadet
appellations.soil_type: Gneiss, mica schist, amphibolite, and granite bedrock
typical_styles: Bone dry, saline minerality, crisp citrus, lees-contact bready texture

appellations.name: Graves
appellations.climate: Maritime temperate, moderated by pine forests
appellations.soil_type: Quartz gravel, pebbles, and clay-sand subsoil
typical_styles: Smoky minerality, dark berries, tobacco, structured and elegant tannins

appellations.name: Bordeaux Supérieur
typical_styles: Plum, blackcurrant, roasted cedar, round fleshy mouthfeel

appellations.name: Costières de Nîmes
appellations.climate: Mediterranean, swept by the Mistral and sea breezes
appellations.soil_type: Rolled siliceous pebbles (grès) over clay subsoil
typical_styles: Sunny fruit, garrigue herbs, stone fruit in whites, generous texture

appellations.name: Pays d'Oc
appellations.climate: Mediterranean, hot dry summers and mild winters
appellations.soil_type: Diverse mosaic of limestone hills, alluvial plains, and schist
typical_styles: Varietally expressive, fruit-forward, approachable balanced structure

appellations.name: Sicilia
appellations.climate: Intense Mediterranean, hot sunny days and sea breezes
appellations.soil_type: Volcanic, calcareous clay, and sandy loam
typical_styles: Dark berry fruit, Mediterranean scrub, warming spice, juicy acidity

appellations.name: Puglia
appellations.climate: Hot Mediterranean with cooling Adriatic winds
appellations.soil_type: Red clay (terra rossa) over limestone bedrock
typical_styles: Sun-ripened dark cherry, dried fig, sweet earthy spices, supple tannins
